evidence: Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and headers to eliminate global logging state and route context logs to individual btck_LoggingConnection instances.
rationale: This resolves a major limitation where multi-context kernel applications receive interleaved, inseparable log output across multiple chainstates. Eliminating global logging state is central to libbitcoinkernel's goal of decoupling kernel code from global node internals.
